oclif.description:
ch-linear is a command-line interface (CLI) for interacting with the Linear GraphQL API from your terminal.

REQUIREMENTS
  The CLI expects the following environment variable to be set:
    • LINEAR_API_KEY – a personal API key obtained from Linear › Settings › API

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --json     Output raw JSON instead of a formatted table
  --limit    Limit the number of records fetched/displayed (when supported)
  --help     Show usage information for any command
examples:
# List all projects in the workspace
ch-linear project list

# View a single issue by its ID with recent comments
ch-linear issue view LIN-1234 --comments

# Create a new issue non-interactively
ch-linear issue create --team ENG --title "Bug: crash on save" --priority 2

# Update an existing issue non-interactively
ch-linear issue edit LIN-1234 --state "In Progress" --title "Refactor auth module"

# Search issues assigned to alice
ch-linear issue search --assignee alice --limit 10

# List all labels in the workspace (raw JSON)
ch-linear label list --json

# List all workflow states (raw JSON)
ch-linear state list --json

# List all teams with pagination limit
ch-linear team list --limit 50

# List all users (raw JSON)
ch-linear user list --json

# List projects and output raw JSON
ch-linear project list --json

issue.description: Create, view, edit, and search Linear issues

label.description: List Linear labels and their metadata
